evidencePassages.text: Utility bills (gas, electricity, water, telephone) dated within the last 6 months

detail: The firm's AML policy §2.3.2 permits utility bills dated within the last 6 months for address verification. CLC AML Guidance specifies utility bills must be less than 3 months old. The firm's written policy sets a lower standard than the regulatory guidance — any address verification relying on a utility bill between 3 and 6 months old would be non-compliant with CLC guidance even if compliant with the firm's own policy.
